description: Bring Your Own Bucket S3 proxy. Connect your own S3-compatible storage (AWS S3, DigitalOcean Spaces, MinIO, Backblaze B2, Wasabi, …) and serve objects through the UnitySVC gateway, which proxies all bytes so the upstream endpoint stays hidden from clients. This is a multi-channel service: the free `byok` channel proxies one bucket you store once as customer secrets (`S3_RELAY_*`, shared with S3 Relay — configure once, use in redirect or proxy mode), while the metered `plus` channel lets you run many buckets under a single account — each enrollment binds its own bucket/endpoint/credentials and is reached at a unique `/e/<code>` address. See “How to use this service” for both channels.
name: s3-proxy

payout_price.description: No platform commission — customer uses own storage
